patch_summary: Linear: the refinement's guard sample must not be a degenerate 1-row activation. The official calibration list ends with a 1-row entry, so `calibration[-1][0].shape[0] < 2` skipped the refinement entirely; the mirror puts that entry first and ran it. Guard on the last entry with >=2 rows. Official mini_sample Linear 0.382698 -> 0.423636 (+204.7 on 50 questions); a no-op where the last entry is already informative (the mirror).
